description: Upload a short preview clip for a software from a local MP4 file. It plays muted when someone points at the card on crela.io, so show the app in use from the first second. MP4 with H.264 video, landscape 16:9 (at least 1280 x 720 px), 3 to 60 seconds, max 80 MB; 15 to 30 seconds work best. Crela hosts the clip itself and does not convert it: export it as H.264 MP4. The file is checked on your disk first (codec, length, size), so a clip Crela would refuse is not uploaded. A new clip replaces the old one and keeps its place on the product page. Use delete_media to remove it. The response says where the clip appears (placement, where): at the top of the product page, or in a clip block if set_product_page placed one. A clip counts toward the ideal presentation (presentation.toward_ideal in check_review_status). Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the MP4 file on disk

name: upload_clip
title: Upload a Crela preview clip
